sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption examined local government responses to its public integrity survey.

sentences.text: The voluntary survey received 1114 responses from local government public officers and asked about perceived risks, experiences and reporting.

cites.document: ICAC Public Integrity Survey 2021 – Local Government Integrity Insights

sentences.text: The Commission reported lower perceived corruption than in its earlier survey, with recruitment favouritism still seen as the leading risk.

cites.document: ICAC Public Integrity Survey 2021 – Local Government Integrity Insights

sentences.text: The Commission recommended further training, clearer employment decisions, controls on outside employment, scrutiny of contracts and protection for people reporting concerns.
